entityId.description: Lowercase kebab-case stable identifier, unique within its entity type.

doctrineSource.description: Citation to the public doctrine or reference material that grounds this record. Required on every ENSIM entity per AGENTS.md — do not add a record without one, and use the 'note' field to flag anything not independently verified.

publication.description: e.g. 'AFDP 3-0.1', 'JP 3-17', 'DAFMAN 13-217', 'DoDD 5100.46', or a named fact sheet/article title.

section.description: Specific section, page, or fact-sheet heading, if applicable.

note.description: Free-text caveat, e.g. 'unit designation not yet verified — confirm before treating as fact.'

participant.description: A reference to any node in the mission execution interaction network — a Role (personnel), C2Node, Organization, or System.

commsLink.description: Detail on a communications or information-flow link: whether it is spoken or digital, what physical/logical medium carries it, and — for digital links — the protocol and message/data format. Per AGENTS.md Section 3, any protocol/format detail must be either a real, public, unclassified specification (e.g. Cursor on Target, PKI/CAC) or explicitly marked representative — never a real classified system's specification.

mode.description: Verbal = spoken communication (radio voice, intercom, in-person). Digital = structured data communication. Mixed = the link combines both, e.g. a spoken briefing built from a written/digital product.

medium.description: The physical or logical bearer carrying this link, e.g. 'UHF/VHF AM voice radio', 'wired aircraft intercom', 'SATCOM datalink', 'tactical mesh radio (MANET)', 'DoD web network (HTTPS)', 'in-person'.

protocol.description: Digital transport/message protocol, when mode is Digital or Mixed, e.g. 'Cursor on Target (CoT) over UDP/TCP', 'HTTPS', 'PKI/CAC certificate-based authentication'. State 'representative' rather than inventing a specific real protocol when none is confirmed.

format.description: Message/data format, when mode is Digital or Mixed, e.g. 'CoT XML event schema', 'TAC plain-text alphanumeric codes (METAR/TAF/PIREP/SIGMET/NOTAM)'. State 'representative' rather than inventing a specific real format when none is confirmed.
